name: Dovetail Regulatory
description: Manage your quality management system directly from Claude. This MCP server lets you create, read and update quality records, documents and traceability links, while QMS Plus, our ISO 13485 validated eQMS, stays the controlled, audit-ready system of record. Built for teams taking a medical device to the FDA or EU MDR.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Dovetail Regulatory to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Dovetail Regulatory to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.withdovetail.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Dovetail Regulatory MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dovetail Regulatory lists 37 MCP tools, including create_document, create_document_version, create_traceability_matrix_link, delete_traceability_matrix_link, edit_data_key, edit_document, edit_document_comments, get_510k, get_agent_run_result, get_dashboard, get_device, and get_devices.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Dovetail Regulatory?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Dovetail Regulatory in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Dovetail Regulatory MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dovetail Regulatory requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Dovetail Regulatory is developed by Dovetail Regulatory. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
